lore.origin: Breley sewer vermin grown fat on refuse and runoff; plague carriers in the underworks.
lore.description: Dog-sized rats with yellowed fangs and patchy fur matted with slime.
lore.weaknesses: Fire and loud noise scatter packs; narrow gratings block pursuit.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: Advantage on melee if ally is within 5 ft of target.
